headline: Eagles without a win in five, but still clear favourites
summary: Go Ahead Eagles have not won in five Eredivisie games — four of them draws — yet they host Telstar as clear favourites: 59% across 10 bookmakers, margin removed. The reason is chance creation: 2.08 expected goals per game, against a Telstar side that lost 4-3 at home to Feyenoord on Saturday. Telstar have won two of the last three meetings, including 4-2 last September, which is why the market stops at about one goal of favouritism. The goals line sits at 3.25, with a 51% chance of over 3.25 goals. With reserve keeper Nick Marsman injured, Eagles signed Jasper Cillessen as cover.
read: Go Ahead Eagles are clear home favourites at 59% despite a five-game winless run of four draws, and their 2.08 xG per game says the chances are there. Telstar arrive with one win in nine but a 4-3 fight against Feyenoord and two recent wins in this fixture, so the market expects goals — around 3.3 — more than a one-sided home cruise.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles are 59% favourites at home to Telstar, whose chance of winning is 17.4%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the home side a clear favourite, more than three times Telstar's chance.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles have drawn their last four Eredivisie games and have not won in five: LDDDD.
facts.meaning: A favourite that keeps dropping points — they have turned wins into draws all autumn.

facts.fact: Eagles' last five games show 2.08 xG created per match against 1.57 allowed, including 2.76 at PEC Zwolle in a 4-1 loss.
facts.meaning: They create enough to win comfortably; the finishing and defending, not the chances, are the problem.

facts.fact: Telstar lost 4-3 at home to Feyenoord on Saturday and have not won in five either: LDLDL.
facts.meaning: Bottom-half form, but they score — five goals in five and a real fight against Feyenoord.

facts.fact: Telstar have beaten Go Ahead Eagles twice in their last three meetings, including 4-2 in September 2025 and 2-1 in the cup in February.
facts.meaning: The head-to-head record runs against the home favourite, which is why the price is not further out.

facts.fact: The market's goals line sits at 3.25, with Over priced at 50.9% and a fair total of about 3.29 goals.
facts.meaning: A high-scoring game is expected: more likely than not this match has at least three or four goals.

facts.fact: The expected goals total slipped from 3.41 to 3.29 in recent days, with Over 3.25 trimmed from 53.3% to 50.9%.
facts.meaning: The market has pulled slightly back from the highest-scoring view but still expects goals.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles have signed 37-year-old goalkeeper Jasper Cillessen until the end of the season after reserve keeper Nick Marsman suffered a knee injury.
facts.meaning: Goalkeeping cover was needed quickly — a sign of a thin department behind the first-choice keeper.

sources.fact: Go Ahead Eagles have signed 37-year-old goalkeeper Jasper Cillessen until the end of the season as cover after reserve goalkeeper Nick Marsman suffered a knee injury.
Dutch outlet Vetkampstraat reports it is still uncertain whether Jasper Cillessen will be included in the Go Ahead Eagles matchday squad against Telstar.
Reserve goalkeeper Nick Marsman is out with a knee injury, which prompted Go Ahead Eagles to bring in Jasper Cillessen.
Go Ahead Eagles reported very positive annual figures on 20 October, with net revenue rising sharply thanks partly to last season's Europa League participation.
Telstar lost 4-3 to Feyenoord in their recent Eredivisie match.
